forbidden_claims: the event is best explained as isolated lower-rift effusion only
the event is best explained as isolated summit collapse only
rainfall-triggered secondary hazards are the dominant mechanism for this diagnosis
the ratio is a complete magma budget or full petrologic accounting
required_claims: summit drainage and lower East Rift Zone effusion are coupled
summit-collapse and lava-flow volumes are roughly equivalent at about 0.8 cubic kilometers each
downrift magma propagation links the summit and lower-rift components

criteria.description: Returns coupled_summit_drainage_lerz_effusion or an equivalent coupled summit-drainage and lower-rift effusion diagnosis.
criteria.name: Coupled diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for recognizing both summit and lower-rift components but not clearly diagnosing coupling.

criteria.description: Identifies the physical index as the summit-collapse to lava-flow volume ratio.
criteria.name: Physical index identification
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for referencing volume comparison without naming the ratio clearly.

criteria.description: Computes or reports the index value as 1.0 from roughly equal 0.8 km3 summit-collapse and lava-flow volumes.
criteria.name: Index value
criteria.partial_credit: 1-3 points for giving the two volumes or approximate equality but not the final ratio.

criteria.description: Uses downrift magma propagation, LERZ fissure opening, 6.8 km fissure extent, high lava rate, or 35.5 km2 lava coverage.
criteria.name: Lower-rift evidence
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for mentioning lower-rift eruption without quantitative or process anchors.

criteria.description: Uses summit partial drainage, near-daily collapses, Mw 4.7 to 5.4 collapse-energy evidence, or Mw 6.9 earthquake context.
criteria.name: Summit-system evidence
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for mentioning summit collapse without mechanism or numeric support.

criteria.description: Rejects isolated rift-only, isolated summit-only, and rainfall-triggered interpretations for mechanism-based reasons.
criteria.name: Alternative rejection
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for rejecting one or two alternatives with limited explanation.

criteria.description: Avoids unsupported claims about casualties, evacuation totals, lava chemistry, gas concentration, ashfall thickness, or a complete magma budget.
criteria.name: No overclaim
criteria.partial_credit: 0.5 points for one minor unsupported extrapolation while preserving the main diagnosis.
